messages:
sarah_s: FYI Aurelia (enterprise) wants to POC aurelia-llama-45b:q4 on Dedicated. asks: catalog entry, KMS/EKM support, memory impact w/ KV cache, and a POC pricing ballpark. can we triage?

devin_m: who is the contact and what's the workload shape?

sarah_s: contact jess@aurelia.ai. workload = multi-turn enterprise summarization + dense retrieval; lots of small requests but long contexts (8k tokens typical) w/ KV cache.

tony_r: q4 quant helps perf/cost but KV cache interactions matter. I can run a quick variant compatibility scan against our a100-80 pool.

ops-bot: scheduled scan job started: job=aura_scan_1296. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization. ETA ~6m.

devin_m: rough pricing delta q4 vs fp16 on Dedicated? any risk premiums for EKM?

tony_r: rough: q4 runtime cost ~ -18% on token compute, but memory overhead for keeping KV cache in fp16 could add infra overhead (~+12%). EKM itself doesn't change runtime cost but ops effort adds a one-time integration fee (shown as setup fee).

ops-bot: scan complete. job=aura_scan_1296. summary: kernel shim required for older drivers; KV-cache works but observed +11% memory overhead; tokenization alignment mismatch in 0.15% of prompts (edge case). full report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/aura_scan_1296/report.html

tony_r: no blocking regression. two action items: 1) small tokenization drift — I have a repro and a patch branch (pr: github.com/redwood/rt/commit/fe12b2) we can land before POC if Aurelia wants exact parity; 2) older A100 nodes need kernel patch — ops can target updated nodes for their Dedicated pool.

sarah_s: jess asked specifically about EKM / external HSM keys for Dedicated. can security confirm?

sec-bot: security Q updated. draft answer: "Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via supported KMS providers. For external key managers (EKM/HSM), we require an ops integration runbook and a short validation window; some restricted environments may require additional compliance review." Please review and confirm.

devin_m: timeline for signed quote + ops validation if Aurelia wants EKM enabled?

tony_r: ops estimate: if no infra changes, validation + smoke tests = 1-2 business days. If we need to enable EKM flow and coordinate with their HSM vendor, plan 3-5 business days for integration and key rotation validation. I'll schedule the work.

sarah_s: pricing: I'll draft a POC quote with two lines — dedicated compute (q4) and one-time integration/setup for EKM. i'll send initial by EOD tomorrow.

devin_m: can we include the failing prompt example so they can validate tokenization locally?

tony_r: dropping repro snippet:

```
# repro prompt causing token shift in ~0.15% of cases
Prompt: "Analyze: \"Customer said: 'we'll proceed'\" — preserve nested quotes and emojis \\ud83d\\ude0a"
```

tony_r: reproduced locally. fix branch ready if they want us to patch before POC.

sarah_s: ok assigning: tony = token-fix + ops prep, devin = quote + customer comms, security-bot = finalize Q doc. I'll send a short summary to jess with the scan link and expected timelines.

devin_m: thanks all. :thumbsup:

sarah_s: closing for now, will reopen if Aurelia asks for extra measurements.
